# WordPress & Hacked Website Recovery India (by WebAdish LLP)

> Emergency WordPress malware removal, hacked-site recovery, blacklist cleanup, and post-incident hardening for Indian businesses. Operated by WebAdish LLP via `wordpressrecovery.in` and `hackedwebsiterecovery.in`.

## Primary services

- [Emergency WordPress recovery](https://www.wordpressrecovery.in/): Triage and recovery for hacked WordPress websites in India.
- [WordPress malware removal India](https://www.wordpressrecovery.in/wordpress-malware-removal-india/): Malware cleanup, backdoor removal, and hardening.
- [Google blacklist removal](https://www.wordpressrecovery.in/google-blacklist-removal-india/): Cleanup and reconsideration support for blacklisted websites.
- [WooCommerce hacked-store recovery](https://www.wordpressrecovery.in/woocommerce-hacked-recovery-india/): Incident response for compromised online stores.
- [Hosting suspension recovery](https://www.wordpressrecovery.in/wordpress-hosting-suspended-malware-india/): Cleanup for malware-related hosting suspensions.
